title: fix(types,layout,plugin-designer)!: the app wizard saves only keys the spec AppSchema declares; the top-level favicon retires (objectui#10842)
body:
Fixes #10842
Clause-②: yes
Corrected from `no` by the seat after the at-tier review: a published accept set on `@object-ui/types` narrows (`favicon` retires on both faces) and `wizardDraftToAppSchema`'s return type changes; the at-tier PASS is on record on this PR.

The Studio's "create app" and "edit app" pages now save an app document that `@objectstack/spec`'s strict `AppSchema` accepts. The app favicon has one spelling, `branding.favicon`.

## Door measurement

**Measured: `422 INVALID_METADATA`.** The base wizard's create payload is refused at the save door. This is the p1 trigger named in the triage.

How it was measured:
- objectstack `origin/main` `de091b50`, in a throwaway `git worktree` under this run's scratch directory. It was never committed, and the shared objectstack checkout was not edited. The `@objectstack/rest` dependency closure (26 packages) was built there.
- A throwaway vitest file drove the REAL `PUT /api/v1/meta/:type/:name` and `GET /api/v1/meta/:type` route handlers of `RestServer`. Under them sit the real `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation`, a real `ObjectQL` engine and in-memory SQLite. This is the harness of objectstack's `meta-view-overlay-options-bag.test.ts`. It runs in-process, not on a booted server, and the auth context is stubbed (`resolveExecCtx`).
- `client.meta.saveItem` sends `PUT /api/v1/meta/app/NAME` with the document as the body (read from the installed `@objectstack/client` 17.4.0).
- The payload is the wizard's exact output. It was produced by running objectui's own `wizardDraftToAppSchema` from base `4aebea0` on a draft shaped the way `AppCreationWizard` builds one: an object entry, a group and a branding block.

| Request | Answer |
|---|---|
| create, the base wizard output | **422** `INVALID_METADATA`, one issue: `unrecognized_keys` at the root, "Unrecognized key(s) on this app: `type`, `title`, `favicon`, `layout`. Did you mean `title` → `label`? …" |
| CONTROL: the same document without those four keys | 200 |
| create, this branch's wizard output | 200 |
| edit: a door-saved app, read back through `GET`, merged the old way with the base output | 422 |
| edit: the same app merged with this branch's output | 200 |
| a legacy row, inserted into `sys_metadata` directly with the old wizard's keys: `GET` serves `type`, `title`, `favicon`, `layout` and `logo` back | (read) |
| edit of that legacy row, spread whole under this branch's output | 422 |
| edit of that legacy row, filtered to the spec's declared keys first (this branch's `EditAppPage` merge) | 200 |

The list door also serves a read decoration, `_diagnostics`. The save door strips it (`stripReadDecorations`), so echoing it is harmless: the served item saved back unchanged answers 200.

## What this does

- **`@object-ui/types`, `wizardDraftToAppSchema`.** It returns only keys the spec's `AppSchema` declares: `name`, `label` (the draft title), `description`, `icon`, `branding` and `navigation`. It writes no `type` (the renderer-node discriminator), no `title`, no top-level `favicon` and no `layout`. Its return type is now the spec's `App` input shape with objectui's `NavigationItem[]` as `navigation`, instead of `AppComponentSchema`. No export is added: `App` was already imported as a type in `app.ts`.
- **`@object-ui/types`, one favicon spelling.** `AppComponentSchema.favicon` is `never` on the TypeScript face. The zod mirror refuses a top-level `favicon` by name through `aliasKeyRefusal`, answering "Did you mean `favicon` → `branding`?". This is the objectui#10827 pattern from PR objectui#10849, applied to the favicon.
- **`@object-ui/layout`.** `AppSchemaRenderer` hands `AppShell` the favicon from `branding.favicon`. The console already reads that spelling through `ConsoleLayout`.
- **`@object-ui/plugin-designer`, `EditAppPage`.** The save keeps the keys the wizard does not maintain, but only keys the spec's `AppSchema` declares. The list comes from `Object.keys(AppSchema.shape)`, computed on first use, the same way app-shell's `ObjectView` reads `ListViewSchema` (`getListViewConfigKeys`). The pre-fill no longer falls back onto a top-level `logo`, `favicon` or `title`. It reads `branding.logo`, `branding.favicon` and `label`.
- **Docs.** The two `content/docs/core/app-schema.mdx` examples and the properties table use `branding.favicon`.

### The key mapping, checked against the spec (W2)

objectstack `origin/main` `de091b50` (`packages/spec/src/ui/app.zod.ts`) and the installed `@objectstack/spec` 17.4.0 agree on each point:
- `AppSchema` is a strict object. `label` is declared and required.
- `title` is in the alias table, and that entry is a refusal hint ("did you mean `title` → `label`?"). The spec does not fold `title` into `label`.
- `favicon` is declared only on `AppBrandingSchema`.
- `type` and `layout` are declared nowhere on an app.

The installed schema's declared top-level keys were read off `AppSchema.shape`.

### Census: top-level app `favicon` (the W3 stop gate)

This census was read at base `4aebea0` over `packages/**`, `apps/**`, `examples/**` and `content/docs/**`, with CHANGELOGs excluded.
- Writers:
  - `wizardDraftToAppSchema`, the only production writer. This PR removes the write.
  - the two `app-schema.mdx` examples and its table row (moved to `branding.favicon`);
  - the fixture in `phase2-schemas.test.ts` (moved);
  - two assertions in `app-creation-types.test.ts` (rewritten);
  - the "local vocabulary still parses" case in `page-app-dashboard-spec-parity.test.ts` (the key removed from it);
  - the zod mirror's own declaration, which is now the refusal.
- Readers: `AppSchemaRenderer` (moved) and `EditAppPage`'s pre-fill fallback (dropped). The runner's `LayoutRenderer` reads no favicon.
- These are not app favicons and are left alone:
  - `AppShellBranding.favicon`. `ConsoleLayout` already feeds it from `activeApp.branding.favicon`, and the `console-architecture.md` example documents that prop.
  - The operator's `branding.faviconUrl` in `runtime-config.ts`, `index.html` and `main.tsx`.

⇒ No writer outside the wizard exists, so the stop condition does not fire.

### File surface outside the claim

- **`packages/plugin-designer/package.json` and `pnpm-lock.yaml`.** `EditAppPage` reads the declared-key list from `@objectstack/spec/ui` at runtime. That is the W4 route "ONE list sourced from the spec", and a restated list was not needed because the spec exports one. plugin-designer's build externalizes every bare import, so the package now declares `@objectstack/spec` `^17.4.0`, the range `@object-ui/types` declares. `check:phantom-deps`, `check:unused-deps`, `check:lockfile-integrity` and `check:lockfile-dedupe` are green.
- **`app-logo-one-spelling-10827.test.ts`, pin (c).** The wizard output is a saved document, not a renderer node, so it no longer carries `type: 'app'`, and the renderer-node mirror cannot judge it. Pin (c) now parses the output with the spec's `AppSchema`, which is the judge at the door. Its intent is unchanged: no top-level `logo`, and the output is accepted.

## Verification (all at `7356c90`)

- **New pins:**
  - `packages/types/src/__tests__/app-declared-keys-10842.test.ts`:
    - the wizard output parses green through the spec's `AppSchema`, and carries no key outside `AppSchema.shape`;
    - `label` and `branding` carry the draft's values, and none of `type`, `title`, `favicon`, `layout` or `logo` is present;
    - CONTROL: the old output, written out as a literal, is refused with one `unrecognized_keys` naming exactly those four keys;
    - the zod mirror refuses a top-level `favicon` (`invalid_type` at `favicon`, message naming `branding`), and `branding.favicon` parses on both schemas;
    - the TypeScript face refuses a top-level `favicon` (`@ts-expect-error`).
  - `packages/layout/src/__tests__/AppSchemaRenderer.brandingFavicon-10842.test.tsx`:
    - `branding.favicon` reaches the `#favicon` link;
    - CONTROL: an app without a favicon leaves the shipped `href` alone;
    - the retired top-level key is not read.
  - `packages/plugin-designer/src/__tests__/EditAppPage.declaredKeys-10842.test.tsx`. It mounts the real `EditAppPage`, with the wizard stubbed to complete with the page's own pre-fill:
    - a legacy served row saves a document the spec accepts;
    - the refused keys and `_diagnostics` are dropped, and `requiredPermissions` and `isDefault` are kept;
    - CONTROL: the served row itself is refused by the spec;
    - the pre-fill ignores a top-level `logo`, `favicon` and `title`;
    - CONTROL: `branding.logo` and `branding.favicon` are pre-filled.
- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/types/ packages/layout/ packages/plugin-designer/ packages/runner/`: `Test Files 311 passed (311)`, `Tests 5905 passed (5905)`.
- `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter @object-ui/types --filter @object-ui/layout --filter @object-ui/plugin-designer --filter @object-ui/runner run type-check` exits 0. Each script is echoed (`packages/X type-check$ tsc --noEmit && … tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`), and each ends `Done`. It ran after a turbo build of the dependency closure. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFilesOnly` lists each new test in its own package.
- **Reverse verification (cross-package type).** A temporary `plugin-designer/src` probe wrote `{ type: 'app', favicon: '/x.ico' }`. `tsc --noEmit` exited 2 with `TS2322: Type 'string' is not assignable to type 'undefined'` at the probe. The probe was removed, and `git status` is clean.
- **Ablation of the converter.** It used objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in WRAP mode, on a committed tree.
  - The mutation re-adds a top-level `title`: the anchor `label: draft.title,` becomes `title: draft.title, label: String(draft.title),`. The anchor count went 1 → 0, and the blob went `0a6753d4dc1a` → `e07a339ac23a`.
  - Result: `4 failed | 15 passed (19)`. The three converter pins and the objectui#10827 pin (c) went red. The CONTROL stayed green, which is the expected direction.
  - Restore: the blob equals HEAD (`0a6753d4dc1a`), and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
  - Two earlier attempts:
    - The first was a no-op. The replacement contained the anchor, so the tool refused it (count 1 → 1), and no test ran.
    - The second, at `3aec465`, also turned the CONTROL red, because the control spread the converter's output. Commit `7356c90` rewrote the control as a literal, and the ablation was run again with the result above.
- **Gates at `7356c90`, all exit 0.** Each is listed with its own verdict line:
  - changesets:
    - `check-changeset-presence`: "11 source file(s) of 3 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)";
    - `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-changeset-overwrite`;
    - `check:changeset-claims`: 13 pending changesets name files touched here. Each paragraph was read, and none speaks of the app favicon, the wizard or these keys;
    - `check:pending-changeset-literals`.
  - `check:new-line-citations` ("0 new citation(s)") and `check:control-bytes`.
  - tests: `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape` and `check:test-path-roots`.
  - dependencies: `check:phantom-deps`, `check:unused-deps`, `check:self-import`, `check:lockfile-integrity`, `check:lockfile-dedupe`, `check:installed-pin-claims` and `check:pre-install-import-graph`.
  - spec and metadata: `check:spec-symbols`, `check:metadata-write-doors`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:designer-field-key-parity`, `check:component-surface-parity` (report-only), `check:esm-specifiers` and `check:readme-exports`.
  - docs:
    - `check:doc-snippets`: "678 of 678 block(s) judged, 0 failed";
    - `check:doc-examples`, `check:doc-types`, `check:doc-fences`, `check:doc-example-ids`, `check:doc-example-readers`, `check-doc-expression-carriage` and `docs:check-links`.
  - `check-governed-queue-guard --test` on the 15 paths: `NOT GOVERNED`.
- `check:spec-floors` exits 1, and none of its findings is in a package this PR touches:
  - four `floor-too-low` findings in `@object-ui/app-shell` (its `^17.3.0` range against 17.4.0 symbols in its `previews` dist);
  - one `no-artifact` for `plugin-tree`, which was not built.
  - `plugin-designer` (`^17.4.0`, new here) and `layout` have no finding.
- **Lint, a declared narrowing:**
  - Population: the rule-bearing objects in `eslint.config.js` match `**/*.{ts,tsx}`. The `.md`, `.mdx`, `package.json` and lockfile changes are outside it.
  - Counted: `eslint --format json` over the 11 touched `.ts`/`.tsx` files gives 11 files, 0 errors and 7 warnings. None of the warnings falls on an added line.
  - Invariance: `eslint.config.js` sets no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`, so no type-aware linting runs, and this diff cannot move a verdict on a file it does not touch.
- NOT MEASURED:
  - Driving the wizard in a real browser against a booted objectstack. The door was measured in-process on objectstack's real route handlers, as above.
  - `@object-ui/app-shell` tests and type-check. This PR changes no app-shell file. The public type changes reach app-shell only through `AppComponentSchema.favicon` and the wizard's return type, and a `git grep` finds no read of either in app-shell. CI runs the full set.

## Acceptance notes

- **The wizard's layout step is no longer saved.** The spec declares no app layout, and no console surface reads one (the standalone runner's `LayoutRenderer` reads the `layout` of its own app JSON). Before this PR, the key blocked the whole save. The Layout radio in `AppCreationWizard` now changes nothing that persists. Whether to retire that step, or to take `layout` to the spec, is a decision named in the report. It is not taken here.
- **A separator nav item from the wizard is still refused.** `addNavItem('separator')` writes `label: ''`, and the spec's separator branch declares no `label`. Measured at the same door, the control document plus one wizard separator answers 422 `unrecognized_keys` at `navigation.2`. This is the divergence the `app.ts` header already records as blocker 3 (objectui's `NavigationItem` requires `label`), so it is not changed here.
- **`EditAppPage` drops a stored `branding.accentColor` on every edit.** Its pre-fill copies only `logo`, `primaryColor` and `favicon` into the draft, and the wizard's `branding` replaces the stored one. Measured with the new page harness: a stored `{ primaryColor, accentColor }` saves as `{ logo: '', primaryColor, favicon: '' }`. This loses a declared key, which is a different class from this card, so it is left as is.
- `AppComponentSchema` still declares its local `title` and `layout`, the renderer-node vocabulary. `AppSchemaRenderer` reads `title`, not `label`. W3 names only the favicon, so those two are not retired here.
- `EditAppPage` still reads `appToEdit.layout` into the wizard's draft. Nothing saves it.
- The spec's retired keys (`version`, `homePageId`, …) are members of `AppSchema.shape` as tombstones. A legacy row carrying one would be kept by the filter, and the door would refuse it with the spec's own prescription. No such row was measured.

## Changeset

`.changeset/10842-wizard-app-declared-keys.md`:
- `@object-ui/types` **minor**, with the break stated: `wizardDraftToAppSchema`'s return shape changed, and `AppComponentSchema.favicon` is `never` and refused by name;
- `@object-ui/layout` **patch**;
- `@object-ui/plugin-designer` **patch**.

This PR was made in session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01MCg3z5cGrV51xEddpGcxEY` (seat `domain:ui#4`).
